scope: Retrospective actual-state local opportunities, not online corrections, official IDSW, a global oracle bound or exclusive causal attribution
reference_definition: First >=3 distinct known accepted past observations, >=.6 consensus, at most first five, frozen per track. Rolling modal reference sensitivity separately reported.
geometry_definition: Appearance-blending eligibility, not a hard Hungarian mask. Threshold feasibility separately measured.
